title: Cookies / Privacy policy
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body:
The list area of the site uses no cookies or analytics:

![2019-01-31t00 08 40-05 00](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/227022/52031878-9a3bc180-24ec-11e9-88d4-6405c3340aac.png)

---

The page at https://blog.remoteintech.company/ does store some cookies:

![2019-01-31t00 11 40-05 00](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/227022/52031940-d707b880-24ec-11e9-90a1-9deb3d2ebbc1.png)

---

WordPress.com will also store some cookies if you've visited the site while logged in.  So it looks like on the https://blog.remoteintech.company/ part of the site, you are subject to the WP.com privacy policy, which hopefully includes reasonable info about the PayPal donation widget.

So this isn't quite as simple as "there's no tracking anywhere on this site".  I'm also not sure it's necessary to add a dedicated privacy page as long as the information is available somewhere.

You could use WP.com's built-in privacy policy widget for this, and add a blurb on the About page... I would think that's good enough.

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body:
Yea I've added the widget to handle the WPcom site for the blog. 

If that is all that is happening on the main site, i.e. nothing, then I'm happy to leave that as-is
